Subject: Metrics lockdown checklist & evidence collection for investor packet

Team —

Board packet deadline is firm: packet goes to Series C Partners on Friday (4/2). I want to lock numbers and have primary evidence for ARR, Q1 bookings, and top-10 deals by EOD Thursday. Please treat this as high priority; below is what I need from each of you by Wednesday COB (3/30) so we have time for one cleanup pass.

Action items (deliver to me + upload to Drive folder linked below):
- Sales ops (Marcus): updated pipeline_stage_snapshot.csv with stage, ARR delta, close probability, and any manual stage overrides for deals > $100k. Include last sales activity timestamp.
- Revenue (Vivek): Q1_bookings_evidence.xlsx — invoice dates, payment terms, signed contract link (DocuSign id or S3 path), and any credit/adjustment notes. Highlight anything booked this week.
- FP&A (Laura): commit_log_2027Q1.csv — list of commits and changes from the forecast hygiene run (who approved, why changed, and supporting doc id).
- Investor one-pager (Stephanie): draft board_metrics_onepager.pdf — top-line ARR, net new ARR, churn, bookings, and one-sentence caveat for any material adjustments.

If anything cannot meet the Wednesday deadline, flag it in reply with the blocker and ETA. We cannot have last-minute manual reconciliations on Thursday — the audit window to reconcile bookings to invoices is small.

Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1QBoardPacket2027Q1

Thanks —
Evelyn
Evelyn Hart
Head of Finance & Ops | Redwood Inference

Eve —

Uploading snapshot now (pipeline_stage_snapshot.csv attached). Quick notes from the stage cleanses we ran today:
- Moved three deals from "commit" -> "best case" after CS confirmed additional technical milestones; total ARR impact ~ $220k. See comment column.
- Two large renewals that were previously in "procurement" have been moved to "closed" — invoices queued.
- Manual probability adjustments: a small set of deals where opportunity owner changed and we backfilled new forecast rationale.

Open items:

2) Data parity: SF->BI extract missed one custom field for activity timestamp; I ran a reconcile and corrected 18 rows. All captured in the attached CSV.
